svg.title: MAS Host for Nehemiah: architecture including PR #20
svg.desc: Application build inputs produce a frozen bundle. CLI or A2A ingress reaches the Rust core. Separate protocol and execution stores support supervised workers, replay and admitted effects. Source associations and invocation exposure stay in execution.sqlite. Optional governance carries complete source restrictions and expiry through later work. Authorised effect and source readers apply current authority and task exposure. Privacy case status preserves uncertainty. Ordinary observation is read-only.
svg.text: Build once. Admit explicitly. Retain enough evidence to recover.
Original deadlines · process-group cleanup · trusted code
The host mediates communication and durable execution. Governed acquisition carries source policy, ancestry
and exposure through later work. Authorised reads preserve settlement, payload disposition and external
